data.name: Hiren
data.gender_notes: Hiren is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hiren is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hīrany', meaning 'golden'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Indra, who is believed to possess immense wisdom and intelligence. Hiren is a name for a boy who is considered to be the lord of his own mind and possesses great intelligence and wisdom. The name Hiren carries the meaning “Lord of the mind, intelligence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hiren usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind, intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Hiren belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the mind, intelligence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hiren total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hiren is deeply rooted in Indian culture and history. It is a special and precious name for a boy, signifying richness and prosperity. Gold is traditionally considered a symbol of wealth, power, and status in Hindu society. By naming a boy Hiren, the parents wish for him to be blessed with the same qualities associated with gold - strength, stability, and a prosperous future.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hiren also holds deep spiritual meaning. The Hindu deity Indra is associated with intellect, power, and leadership, and is believed to be the god of rain, thunder, and electricity. By invoking the name of this deity, a boy named Hiren is believed to be imbued with divine blessings of wisdom, knowledge, and the power to overcome challenges. He is also thought to be the master of his own mind, possessing the intelligence and understanding to navigate through life's complexities and make wise decisions. The name Hiren serves as a daily reminder for the boy to strive for wisdom, power, and prosperity, and to honor the divine being Indra within himself.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hiren, meaning 'one who possesses wealth in wisdom', signifies an enlightened soul, rich in knowledge and inner peace. It symbolizes the pursuit of spiritual riches over material wealth.

historical_references.reference: Hiren was a legendary king of the Haihayas dynasty in the 13th century CE. He is known for his valor and justice, and is considered a revered figure in Hindu mythology.
